text.en:
The salary of the chief interpreter and translator in the office of the Superintendent of Police in the
city of Manila is hereby increased to one hundred dollars per month, in money of the United States.

This Act shall take effect on the first day of November, nineteen hundred.
Enacted, October 24, 1900.
